article.story: WINNIPEG, Manitoba -- — Rookie Judd Caulfield scored his first NHL goal and added an assist to help the Anaheim Ducks beat Winnipeg 5-1 on Friday night for the Jets' first regulation loss of the season. Tim Washe and Mikael Granlund each had a goal and an assist, and Sam Colangelo and Nikita Nesterenko also scored to help the Ducks improve to 3-1-0. Lukas Dostal stopped 15 shots for Anaheim, allowing only Kyle Conner's goal. After the Jets trimmed it to 3-1 midway through the third period, Granlund sunk Winnipeg’s hopes with a goal with 5:54 remaining. Conner, who was playing in his 700th NHL game, pulled the Jets to 3-1 when Mark Scheifele sent him in alone on Dostal for his sixth goal of the season. Clay Stevenson made 12 saves for Winnipeg. The Jets are 3-1-1. Up next Ducks: At Calgary on Saturday night. Jets: Host Minnesota on Tuesday night. ------ See AP’s full NHL coverage here
